'''Rwookrrorro''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. Founded thousands of years before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], this metropolitan center of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] homeworld was a kilometer-wide platform nested high atop a tangle of huge [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|trees]]. Among Rwookrrorro's most famous citizens were [[Zaalbar]], who aided the former [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] in his quest to find the [[Star Map]]s, and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], one of the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]].

==History==
===Jedi Civil War===
[[File:Rwookrrorro-K1concept.jpg|thumb|left|Rwookrrorro during the [[Jedi Civil War]].]]
During the [[Jedi Civil War]] the city was run by [[Chuundar]], who was involved with [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] slavers. During [[Revan/Legends|Revan's]] search for the [[Star Map]]s he entered a Czerka spaceport not far from the city. As he prepared to enter it he was stopped by a guard and his [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] companion [[Zaalbar]] was captured. Chuundar held Zaalbar captive until Revan could journey into the [[Shadowlands/Legends|Shadowlands]] to kill a [[Madclaw]]. During his journey into the Shadowlands he met [[Jolee Bindo]], a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who helped him find the Star Map, and the madclaw, who turned out to be [[Freyyr]].<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic" />

When Revan returned to the city, Freyyr was confronting Chuundar, as they argued, Revan convinced Zaalbar to side with Freyyr, together they teamed together to [[Rebellion on Kashyyyk/Legends|defeat]] Chuundar, his followers, and his Czerka allies. After the battle, Zaalbar left with Revan to continue his [[Life debt/Legends|life debt]] and was rewarded with [[Bacca's Ceremonial Blade]]. The Wookiees drove the Czerka slavers out of Rwookrrorro, and the city was freed from slavers.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic" />

===Galactic Civil War===
[[File:House_exterior_rmq.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The [[Chewbacca's home|house]] of [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and his family in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].]]
During the time of the [[Jedi Civil War]], Rwookrrorro was little more than a tree-top village, but over time it expanded to become Kashyyyk's most prominent settlement and [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]].

Rwookrrorro, as of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], comprised a kilometer-wide platform supported within a tangle of [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|wroshyr trees]]. Thanks to their knowledge of technology, the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] further supported this natural nest with [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]]. Primitive-looking huts lined the edges of Rwookrrorro's streets, while a huge, hollowed-out branch served as a hidden hangar for offworlders looking to evade [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] entanglements. Lift cars were used to traverse the levels of the Wookiee trees. The [[Rryatt Trail]] led from the city to the [[Well of the Dead]].

During the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|Battle of Kashyyyk]] following the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Rwookrrorro was severely damaged by [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] from [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]].<ref name="The Rise of Darth Vader">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref> The tree-city was also the home of [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and his family.<ref name="Holiday Special">''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Rwookrrorro_forest-SWHS.png|thumb|left|The ''Millennium Falcon'' flying over the forests of Rwookrrorro.]]
Chewbacca's home city first appeared in the [[1978]] TV movie ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]'', albeit unnamed. A shot of Han Solo's [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] flying over the canopy of the city was included in the special.<ref name="Holiday Special" /> The forests of Kashyyyk featured in the movie were in fact that of the [[Tikal]] site, a ruined city of the [[Wikipedia:Maya civilization|Maya civilization]]. The same location had been used [[1977|one year earlier]] to portray the landscape of the jungle moon [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] in the first ''Star Wars'' movie, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> Tikal [[Wikipedia:Tikal Temple III|Temple III]] can be spotted in the background of the shot.<ref name="TKP">{{WebCite|url=http://www.tikalpark.com/temple.htm|text=Tikalpark.com|archivedate=20020712180144}}</ref>

When writing ''[[Heir to the Empire]]'', author [[Timothy Zahn]] planned Rwookrrorro to be the name of the Wookiee homeworld. When he was told that it had already been named "Kashyyyk", he suggested that Rwookrrorro could be the indigenous Wookiee name, but this idea was rejected. Zahn re-appropriated the name for a city on Kashyyyk instead.<ref name="HTTE20">''[[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition]]''</ref> Rwookrrorro later appeared in additional ''Star Wars'' media. Rwookrrorro was also mentioned in the [[2001]] comic ''[[What They Called Me]]''.
